property_summary: After deploying C with owner initially 0x0 (address(0)), calling owned() as a non-owner succeeds on the buggy version (require(msg.sender != owner) passes) but reverts in the reference version (require(msg.sender == owner) fails); the observable divergence is whether the call reverts.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so it passes only when msg.sender is NOT the owner
